name: onescanpicker
description: OneScan Intelligent Picking & Verification for SAP BTP

scripts.deploy:db: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try { fs.unlinkSync('db.sqlite'); } catch (e) {}" && cds deploy --to sqlite:db.sqlite
scripts.start:backend: npm run deploy:db && npm run generate:dashboard-data && cds watch --port 4004
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,ui5 "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ui5"
